limitations: Unwired candidate only: outer importer retains ownership of inventory, staging and atomic publication.
Original AES-GCM Snapshot envelopes can be verified and read by the host-only seam when an explicit epoch-bound native key authority is supplied; no key or decrypted payload is persisted.
The public native read operation remains unavailable for encrypted payloads until the integrator binds the host-authorized seam and trusted import receipt.

Original subscription state contains a plaintext private key and is blocked rather than copied or redacted; a separate native secret store and durable reference are required before original state can migrate.
Recovery Session history, cache and published snapshots require separate complete migration.
Validated plaintext snapshot bytes are preserved without claiming restore support.
